About

From customer-facing work to building AI.

After years in international sales, customer service and team leadership (managing a 250,000+ client base), I moved into AI. Today I write prompts, build no-code and code-based AI agents and automations, and use generative AI to create landing pages and full websites, from prompt to published page. I turn repetitive, slow work into reliable, precise solutions, with complete understanding and genuine care for my client’s needs.

I completed the AI Solutions Architect program at HackerU and hold the certificate.

Selected Work

Projects

AI Tool  /  Compliance

Benefits Audit Engine

A browser-based tool that ingests a payroll export (Excel/CSV) and validates each employee’s pension, study-fund, severance and national-insurance contributions against current Israeli labor law. It flags every legal exception per employee and exports a monthly compliance report with charts, turning a slow, error-prone manual check into a fast, reliable one.

AI Agent  /  Automation

Organic Leads Agent

An automated AI agent that finds and qualifies organic leads end to end. It collects potential leads from online sources, enriches and scores each one by relevance and fit, and delivers a clean, ready-to-contact list, replacing hours of manual prospecting with a fast, repeatable flow that keeps the pipeline full.

Landing Pages

A series of landing pages and social campaign visuals built end to end with generative AI. I wrote and refined the prompts, generated the imagery and layouts with Gemini and Nano Banana, and shaped a consistent, on-brand visual language across the whole set. Privacy Policy

Last updated: 2026.

This website is the professional portfolio of Shai Marom, where I showcase my work and offer AI services to businesses. This policy explains what information is collected and how it is used.

What I collect. If you use the contact form, I collect the name, email address and phone number you provide. Nothing else is collected about you, and the site has no analytics or advertising trackers.

Why. Your details are used only to respond to your enquiry about my work or services and to get back to you. They are never sold, rented or shared with third parties for marketing.

How it is handled. Form submissions are delivered to my email through a form-relay service (FormSubmit) and stored in my email inbox.

Cookies and storage. The site uses only essential local storage to remember your language preference. There are no tracking or advertising cookies.

Your rights. You can ask me to see, correct or delete the details you sent at any time. Just email me and I will take care of it.

Fonts. The site loads web fonts from Google Fonts, so Google receives your IP address when the page loads. No other data is shared with Google.
